cmd-admin-setmax: Change the limit of a user
cmd-admin-broadcast: Send a message to all users
welcome-body: I watch Vinted searches for you and send a message the moment a new item shows up.
how-to-start-1: 1. Open Vinted, set your filters and copy the URL from the address bar.
how-to-start-3: 3. That is it — new items land in this chat.
help-url-body: Search on Vinted with the filters you want, then copy the address of the results page. It has to be a /catalog page and contain at least one filter, for example a category, a brand, a size or a price.
ask-url: Send me the URL of your Vinted search. It looks like this: https://www.vinted.fr/catalog?brand_ids[]=53&price_to=50 /cancel aborts.
ask-name: How should I call this search? Send - to use {suggestion}.
ask-banned-keywords: Any words that should never appear in a result? Separate them with commas, or send - for none.
ask-banned-keywords-edit: Current banned words: {current} Send the new list separated by commas, or - to clear it.
invalid-url: That is not a valid URL.
not-a-vinted-url: That URL does not point to Vinted.
invalid-url-with-example: I need a catalog page, for example https://www.vinted.co.uk/catalog?...
must-have-query-params: The URL has no filters at all. Set some filters on Vinted first.
must-have-supported-filter: The URL must contain at least one filter, for example a category, brand, size or price.
not-your-subscription: This search belongs to someone else.
no-subscriptions: You have no searches yet. Send /add to create one.
subscription-limit-exceeded: You reached your limit of {limit} search(es). Delete one first, or ask an administrator for more.
not-allowed-to-create-subscriptions: The administrator disabled creating new searches.
not-authorized: You are not allowed to use this bot.
unknown-input: I did not expect that. Send /help to see what I can do.
generic-error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
inactivity-question: Nothing was found for {name} in a while. Keep watching it? Without an answer it is deleted in {hours} hours.
subscription-deleted-inactive: The search {name} was deleted because it stayed inactive.
admin-broadcast-usage: Send me the message you want every user to receive, or use /admin_broadcast <text>. /cancel aborts.
nothing-to-send: There is no message waiting to be sent.
